headline: On October 19, 2019: MPs met at the House of Lords for Brexit talks
captionCards: First Saturday sitting in the House of Lords since 1982
Marked a crucial moment in UK's Brexit negotiations
instagramCaption:
The House of Lords hosted a rare Saturday sitting. \\[The House of Lords, the upper house of the UK Parliament, convened on October 19, 2019, to discuss the UK's Brexit deal. This was the first Saturday sitting since April 3, 1982, during the Falklands War. The meeting took place in the Palace of Westminster, London. This event marked a significant moment in the UK's political history, highlighting the urgency and importance of the Brexit negotiations. \\Why do you think this meeting was so significant? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
